info.name: DigiBank-DAST-Validation
info.description: Final DAST validation collection for DigiBank (Workshop 3). It replays functional regression, input-validation, error-handling, information-exposure, and remediation checks against a running DigiBank instance. All URLs use the {{baseUrl}} environment variable so the same collection runs locally and in CI with Newman.
